comment: A conversation of Claude Code read from the start (head) and the end (tail) of its file (D-353). The folder is the first cwd; the first message is the first message of the person on one line, not a meta note and not a command or its output in tags; a picture message gives its text. The name is the last title the person gave (custom-title), else the last title of Claude Code (ai-title), else the start of the first message. Where it was started comes from the entry point: cli is a terminal, claude-vscode VS Code, claude-desktop the desktop app; an sdk entry point is a program such as claude -p and is no conversation. A conversation with neither a message nor a title is none. A line cut at the edge of a piece is skipped. id, environment and lastUsed are passed as they are: c1, Aiko, 1000.
